verdict.rationale: Chronicle documents querying telemetry events through its SDK and a REST endpoint (events.search / POST /v1/search for semantic search over event content), so an agent could programmatically pull trace data to debug. There is no evidence of programmatic access to metrics or eval results, and no first-party MCP server; the MCP mention refers only to MCP servers inside simulated environments. Missing for 10: documented API access to eval results/scores and metrics, an official MCP server for querying observability data, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven debugging.
